claims.title: Actual-generator direct summand by an invertible coefficient minor
claims.statement: For a finite monomial support and any generating set G over a DVR, select a residue-field basis from reduced G. A unit coefficient minor gives a retraction onto the lifts, an actual-generator basis and a direct summand of rank exactly dim(span of reduced G). This proves RestSel, without estimating that dimension.

claims.title: Saturated residue bases and injective monomial tensor assembly
claims.statement: A finite free saturated polynomial lattice has residue-independent basis reductions; support intersections preserve saturation. An injective map of labelled tuples of support monomials makes the associated direct sum of tensor-product spaces inject into the product polynomial module. Successive quotient/remainder in n=ell+P(u+Qv) explains the exact source exponent recovery.
assumptions: Saturation of the given segment modules
Injectivity of the labelled support exponent map
remaining_inputs: For the actual RestLam application: full NestedTypeBound saturation identification, LamGeo verification and exact row-degree matching RestLamDeg.

claims.title: Periodic frame predecessors and nonvanishing of the determinant multiplier
claims.statement: The last r even predecessors of a late letter span less than a period and have distinct residues. Each substituted determinant evaluates to 1 at its own diagonal assignment. Its reduction is nonzero; their finite product remains nonzero in the residue polynomial domain. This proves DiscriminantNonzeroModUniformiser pointwise for valid frames.
assumptions: The exact periodic frame validity hypotheses
Positive substitution exponents and a domain residue ring

claims.title: Normal-degree bound with Cdeg=10 and a sharper intermediate expression
claims.statement: Writing N=|TT|, A=La*a/(p*k), B=a*p^(-L1), every polynomial in the actual selected generator span has normal degree <=N*(A+10B+kQ), hence <=10N*(A+B+kQ). Old-frame variables have zero normal weight; late letters tile one period; digit labels contribute <=NkQ. This proves RestDeg and the degree clause of Conclusion2 under the supplied hypotheses.
assumptions: Dat.Hyp, including even period and frame validity

claims.title: Residue rank transfer through the actual nonzero determinant multiplier
claims.statement: If each reduced Delta-times-coarse-generator is a reduced actual generator, multiplication by reduced Delta injects LamBar into NNbar. SD1 then yields an integral actual-generator summand of at least the coarse residue dimension. Graphs of linear maps give nPl>=q^(rK), including the correct handling of a nonpositive target bound.
remaining_inputs: GeneratorModuloUniformiser for the actual coarse and fine symbol families
The quantitative lower bound on dim(LamBar)

claims.title: A union-bound digit count and the terminal-path degree estimate
claims.statement: For r>=2,Q>2b, a truncated cube has >=Q^(r-1)*(1-2rb/Q) solutions to any prescribed sum congruence, by deleting forbidden coordinates from Q^(r-1) full solutions. Interlacing telescopes to d<=mu_new,1-mu_old,k<=2b for terminal path degrees. Under 4Yb<=Q these prove the exact RestMon row factor, retaining the path and terminal index.
remaining_inputs: BetaRatioBound 4Y*beS<=Qc for the actual parameters; the separate good-path abundance estimate.

claims.title: Elementary compression of the rank losses to coefficient one
claims.statement: For J<=N,r>=2,k>=5,Y>=1 and 1-1/(32Y)<=alpha<=1, a positive target 1-Nr^2k/Y is <=alpha^J*((1-5/Y)(1-1/Y)(1-r/(2Y)))^N. The proof uses product(1-x)>=1-sum x and Bernoulli. A nonpositive rank target is separately trivial. This explains Crk=1 without claiming the preceding source factor bounds proved.
remaining_inputs: The actual SumFacts component bounds and residue-family product/sum identities.

claims.title: Exact quantitative selected-symbol target and remaining density frontier
claims.statement: The pinned route chooses C0=1088,Crk=1,Cdeg=10. SD closes RestSel, DiscriminantNonzeroModUniformiser and RestDeg. Full residue rank still requires the coarse-generator congruence, actual RestLam support/degree/saturation identifications, good-path RestSeg construction and abundance, and RestPad/RestSum numerical aggregation. Hence Conclusion2 rank is not yet claimed as a complete human proof.
remaining_inputs: Actual RestLam geometry, degree matching and saturation identification
RestSeg: RestMem, RestInd, GoodPathWeight and BetaRatioBound
RestPad and complete RestSum identities and parameter estimates
